questions.stem: The torque of a force $5 \hat{i}+3 \hat{j}-7 \hat{k}$ about the origin is $\tau$. If the force acts on a particle whose position vector is $2 \hat{i}+2 \hat{j}+\hat{k}$, then the value of $\tau$ will be :
questions.solution: Torque is $\vec\tau=\vec r\times\vec F$. Its components are $(2(-7)-1(3),\;1(5)-2(-7),\;2(3)-2(5))=(-17,19,-4)$. Therefore $\vec\tau=-17\hat i+19\hat j-4\hat k$.
